pages.text: Press $(k:puffish_skills.open) and plan before you spend — six skill trees, and skill points come from completing Heracles quests ($(k:heracles.open_quests)), not from grinding combat or XP.$(br2)$(bold)Respeccing:$() 5 XP levels per point refunded. Full respec is possible but expensive.

$(bold)The Six Trees$()$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Warfare$() — Melee damage, weapon mastery, combat stats$(li)$(bold)Marksman$() — Ranged damage, arrow handling, precision$(li)$(bold)Sorcery$() — Spell power, mana, cast efficiency$(li)$(bold)Fortitude$() — HP, defense, regen, resistance$(li)$(bold)Gathering$() — Mining, farming, fishing, luck$(li)$(bold)Engineering$() — Crafting, machine bonuses, automation speed

$(bold)Point Budget$()$(br2)A fully completionist player who finishes every quest in every tier earns approximately $(bold)75 skill points$() total. Each tree has 40 levels of investment.$(br2)$(bold)240 total points$() would be required to max all six trees — this is intentionally unreachable. Build choices matter. You will specialize.$(br2)Anti-farming: Pufferfish Unofficial Additions prevents grinding specific XP sources for points.

$(bold)Tree Structure$()$(br2)Each tree has:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)8-node trunk$() — always available, foundational bonuses$(li)$(bold)2 branches$() — unlock after trunk nodes, specialize into substyles$(li)$(bold)1 capstone$() — requires near-full tree investment, powerful late bonus$(br2)Branching at each fork is exclusive — you choose one branch or the other. Not both.$(br2)$(bold)Next: open $(k:puffish_skills.open) and pick the tree that matches your class.$()
